[Iteration 0] Generated requirements specification:
- 10 User Needs
- 10 Functional Requirements
- 7 Non-Functional Requirements
- 10 User Stories

[Iteration 1] Generated requirements specification:
- 13 User Needs
- 12 Functional Requirements
- 6 Non-Functional Requirements
- 12 User Stories

[Iteration 2] Generated requirements specification:
- 13 User Needs
- 13 Functional Requirements
- 6 Non-Functional Requirements
- 12 User Stories

user_needs.user_need: I need to access football news, live scores, and team/player information quickly and smoothly so that I can stay informed about my favorite teams and competitions.
user_needs.user_journey: User opens the app to check news, scores, and information about their favorite teams and competitions.

user_needs.user_need: I want to personalize my app experience by selecting favorite teams, sports channels, notification preferences, and news types so that I receive relevant news and live updates.
user_needs.user_journey: User configures preferences for teams, channels, notification types, and news categories after registration or in settings.

user_needs.user_need: I want to receive real-time notifications about news and results for my favorite teams so that I never miss important updates.
user_needs.user_journey: User enables notifications and receives push alerts for selected teams and events.

user_needs.user_need: I want to watch live streams of matches when available and permitted in my country so that I can follow games directly from the app.
user_needs.user_journey: User accesses live stream links for matches, with access controlled by transmission rights and location.

user_needs.user_need: I want to share news and match reports via social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Instagram) so that I can engage with my friends and community.
user_needs.user_journey: User reads news or reports and shares them directly from the app to supported social platforms.

user_needs.user_need: I want the app to function reliably and remain usable even with limited or intermittent network coverage so that I can access information anytime, anywhere.
user_needs.user_journey: User accesses the app in areas with poor connectivity and expects core features to remain available.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to support up to 100,000 concurrent users without performance loss so that we can handle high traffic on match days.
user_needs.user_journey: Large numbers of users access the app simultaneously during peak events.

user_needs.user_need: I need all user data to be processed in compliance with GDPR so that we protect user privacy and meet legal requirements.
user_needs.user_journey: User registers, logs in, and uses the app, with all data handled according to GDPR.

user_needs.user_need: I want to register and log in quickly and easily, including with third-party authentication (Google, Apple, Facebook), so that I can start using the app without unnecessary delays.
user_needs.user_journey: User downloads the app and completes registration/login at startup using email/password or third-party authentication.

user_needs.user_need: I want the app to be thoroughly tested and improved based on user feedback so that malfunctions are minimized and user satisfaction increases.
user_needs.user_journey: App undergoes QA testing before release and is updated based on ongoing user reviews and feedback.

user_needs.user_need: I want the app to support localization for English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian so that it is accessible to users in our target markets.
user_needs.user_journey: User selects or is auto-detected for their preferred language during onboarding or in settings.

user_needs.user_need: I want to access previously loaded news, scores, and team/player information offline for at least 7 days so that I can stay informed even without internet.
user_needs.user_journey: User opens the app offline and expects to see cached news, scores, and team/player info from the past 7 days.

user_needs.user_need: I want live stream links to open in an in-app browser or native player for a seamless viewing experience.
user_needs.user_journey: User taps a live stream link and the stream opens within the app, not in an external browser.

functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall load and display the main dashboard with news, live scores, and team/player information within 2 seconds of app launch.

The system shall allow users to select and manage their favorite teams, sports channels, notification preferences (including goals, cards, match start, match end, news, and transfers), and news types for personalized content.

The system shall provide real-time notifications to users about news and results for their selected favorite teams and according to their notification preferences, including goals, cards, match start, match end, news, and transfers.
The system shall display live stream links for matches only when the broadcast is available and permitted in the user's country.
The system shall enable users to share news articles and match reports directly to Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and Instagram from within the app.
The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded news, scores, and team/player information for up to 7 days when network connectivity is unavailable.
The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users without degradation in performance during peak usage.
The system shall process all personal user data in compliance with GDPR requirements.
The system shall allow users to register and log in directly at app startup with a streamlined process, supporting email/password and third-party authentication (Google, Apple, Facebook).
The system shall undergo comprehensive testing before release and support continuous improvement based on user feedback collected via in-app forms and app store reviews.
The system shall support localization for English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian.

The system shall open live stream links in an in-app browser or native player for a seamless viewing experience. Advanced playback features such as Chromecast, AirPlay, and picture-in-picture are out of scope.
The system shall refresh cached news, scores, and team/player information automatically when the user is online and provide a manual refresh option in the app.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall achieve a cold start time (from app launch to main dashboard ready) of no more than 2 seconds on supported devices (Android/iOS).
The system shall maintain 99.9% uptime during peak match days.
The system shall ensure all user data is encrypted in transit and at rest, in accordance with GDPR.
The system shall provide a user interface that is consistent and accessible across all modules and device types, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA compliance and supporting screen readers.
The system shall remain responsive and usable with network latency up to 500ms for all critical API calls and during temporary loss of connectivity.
The system shall log all access to live stream links for audit and compliance purposes.

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want the app to load and display the main dashboard within 2 seconds so that I can quickly access news and live scores.

acceptance_criteria.given: the app is installed on a supported device and closed
acceptance_criteria.when: the user launches the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the main dashboard with news, live scores, and team/player info is fully loaded within 2 seconds

acceptance_criteria.scenario: App launch under poor network conditions
acceptance_criteria.given: the device has limited connectivity
acceptance_criteria.when: the user launches the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard loads previously cached data within 2 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: the app is online and API response time is up to 500ms
acceptance_criteria.when: the user launches the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard loads and displays current data within 2 seconds

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to select my favorite teams, sports channels, notification preferences, and news types so that I receive personalized news and live updates.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Selecting favorite teams, channels, and preferences
acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user navigates to preferences and selects teams, channels, notification types, and news categories
acceptance_criteria.then: the app saves the preferences and displays personalized content

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is editing notification preferences
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects or deselects notification types (goals, cards, match start, match end, news, transfers)
acceptance_criteria.then: the app updates the notification settings accordingly

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to receive real-time notifications about my favorite teams according to my preferences so that I never miss important news or results.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Receiving a notification for a favorite team
acceptance_criteria.given: the user has enabled notifications and selected favorite teams and notification types
acceptance_criteria.when: a relevant news or result event occurs (goal, card, match start, match end, news, transfer)
acceptance_criteria.then: the user receives a push notification on their device

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to access live stream links for matches when available and permitted so that I can watch games directly from the app.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is in a country with broadcast rights and a live match is ongoing
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the match details
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays the live stream link

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Live stream not permitted in region
acceptance_criteria.given: the user is in a country without broadcast rights
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the match details
acceptance_criteria.then: the app does not display the live stream link

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to share news and match reports via Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and Instagram so that I can engage with my friends.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a news article
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the share button and selects Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, or Instagram
acceptance_criteria.then: the article is shared to the selected platform

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to remain usable and display cached news, scores, and team/player information for up to 7 days even when offline so that I can access information anytime.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has previously loaded news, scores, and team/player info
acceptance_criteria.when: the device is offline and the user opens the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays the cached news, scores, and team/player info from the past 7 days

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has not connected to the internet for more than 7 days
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the app offline
acceptance_criteria.then: the app notifies the user that cached data is outdated and prompts to reconnect

acceptance_criteria.given: the device is online and cached data is older than the latest available
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app automatically refreshes news, scores, and team/player info

acceptance_criteria.given: the device is online
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the manual refresh button
acceptance_criteria.then: the app fetches and updates news, scores, and team/player info

acceptance_criteria.scenario: API latency tolerance for offline refresh
acceptance_criteria.given: the device is online and API response time is up to 500ms
acceptance_criteria.when: the user triggers a manual or automatic refresh
acceptance_criteria.then: the app updates cached data and remains responsive

user_stories.user_story: As a product manager, I want the app to support up to 100,000 concurrent users without performance loss so that we can handle high traffic on match days.

acceptance_criteria.given: 100,000 users are connected simultaneously
acceptance_criteria.when: users access live scores and news
acceptance_criteria.then: the app remains responsive and performant

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want my personal data to be processed securely and in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy is protected.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user registers and uses the app
acceptance_criteria.when: personal data is transmitted or stored
acceptance_criteria.then: the data is encrypted and processed according to GDPR

user_stories.user_story: As a new user, I want to register and log in quickly at app startup using email/password or third-party authentication so that I can start using the app without delay.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Successful registration and login with email/password
acceptance_criteria.given: the user opens the app for the first time
acceptance_criteria.when: the user completes the registration/login form with email and password
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is logged in and directed to the main dashboard

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Successful registration and login with third-party authentication
acceptance_criteria.given: the user opens the app for the first time
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects Google, Apple, or Facebook login and completes authentication
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is logged in and directed to the main dashboard

user_stories.user_story: As a product manager, I want the app to be thoroughly tested and improved based on user feedback so that malfunctions are minimized and user satisfaction increases.

acceptance_criteria.given: the app is ready for release
acceptance_criteria.when: QA testing is performed
acceptance_criteria.then: all critical issues are resolved before launch

acceptance_criteria.given: the app is live and users submit feedback via in-app forms
acceptance_criteria.when: feedback is received
acceptance_criteria.then: feedback is reviewed and prioritized for future releases

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Continuous improvement from app store reviews
acceptance_criteria.given: the app is live and receives app store reviews
acceptance_criteria.when: reviews are analyzed
acceptance_criteria.then: improvements are planned and implemented in future releases

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to use the app in English, German, Spanish, French, or Italian so that I can interact with the app in my preferred language.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user opens the app for the first time
acceptance_criteria.when: the app detects or prompts for language selection
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays all content and UI in the selected language

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user changes the language in app settings
acceptance_criteria.then: the app updates all content and UI to the new language

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want live stream links to open in an in-app browser or native player so that I have a seamless viewing experience.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user taps a live stream link
acceptance_criteria.when: the stream is available and permitted
acceptance_criteria.then: the stream opens in an in-app browser or native player, not an external browser

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Advanced playback features out of scope
acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a live stream
acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to use Chromecast, AirPlay, or picture-in-picture
acceptance_criteria.then: the app does not provide these features

gaps_and_recommendations.title: No Gaps Remaining
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: All previously identified gaps have been addressed per supervisor feedback.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Continue to validate requirements with stakeholders as implementation progresses.

input: We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices. It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting. With our app, we want to offer football fans a central platform where they can stay comprehensively informed at all times. To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams and also select preferred sports channels individually. In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker. Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international. Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time. Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun. Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained. Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country. The LiveFootball app should also give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time. To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time. The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly. The user interface is a key component of the app and connects various modules that are displayed together and managed via the interface. The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data. The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server. The server is located outside the app and provides the data dynamically so that the live ticker module can access it flexibly. In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface. Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated. All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates. Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup. Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams. In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app. We are aware that many mobile apps have to operate under difficult conditions. Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage. The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection. On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss. To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early. In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality. Data protection is our highest priority. All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR.
